title: SerreSectionModuleComponentFinite
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x_0,x_1], P=Proj S as in [def-sc-p1-standard], and G a coherent O_P-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let M be an S-module with additive subgroups M_z, with S_e M_z contained in M_(e+z), and additive isomorphisms phi_z:M_z -> Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0 respecting homogeneous multiplication via twistMul of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. For each n>=0, the S-submodule spanned by M_n is finitely generated. This is a separate statement for each degree and supplies no bound on generators of the whole M.

source.place: Stacks Project, Lemma 01YS (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YS), proof of (5); online text read because the local checkout is absent

proof.text: Each twist is invertible, so G tensor O(n) is coherent by local triviality. Transport to the standard projective line using the Proj chart isomorphism and twist comparison. Identify H^0 with global sections and apply finiteDimensional_H to obtain a finite k-basis.

The scalar-compatibility formula with a=C(c), degree e=0, says phi_n is k-linear for restriction of scalars on M_n; on local fractions twistMul by C(c) is exactly multiplication by c. Pull back the finite basis. Its S-span contains M_n and is contained in the S-span of M_n, hence is equal to that span. Thus the span is finitely generated. The zero section space uses an empty basis, and n=0 needs no separate case.
